/v1/internal/billing/admissions:
    post:
      operationId: createAdmission
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-billing
      x-kokoro-visibility: internal-owner
      x-kokoro-stability: experimental
      x-kokoro-idempotency: required
      x-kokoro-permission: agent-model-studio-service
      security:
        - tenantContext: []
          serviceCaller: []
          internalSecret: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/TenantId"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/IdempotencyKey"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/ConsumptionToken"
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/AdmissionCreateRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Success
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
            Location:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/Location"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AdmissionResponse"
        "400":
          description: Request failed
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.invalid_request
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "401":
          description: Authentication required
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.unauthenticated
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "403":
          description: Forbidden
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.forbidden
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "404":
          description: Not found
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.not_found
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "409":
          description: Conflict
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.idempotency_conflict
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "422":
          description: Invalid state
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.price_unavailable
              retryable: false
            - code: billing.insufficient_credit
              retryable: false
            - code: billing.invalid_state
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          description: Internal failure
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.internal_error
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.dependency_unavailable
              retryable: true
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      description:
        Creates and commits the admission resource and any authorized hold.
        A durable command-receipt replay returns the original creation
        representation; business status remains queryable.
  /v1/internal/billing/admissions/{admission_id}:
    get:
      operationId: getAdmission
      x-kokoro-owner: kokoro-billing
      x-kokoro-visibility: internal-owner
      x-kokoro-stability: experimental
      x-kokoro-idempotency: read-only
      x-kokoro-permission: agent-model-studio-service
      security:
        - tenantContext: []
          serviceCaller: []
          internalSecret: []
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/TenantId"
        - name: admission_id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/AdmissionResponse"
        "400":
          description: Request failed
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.invalid_request
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "401":
          description: Authentication required
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.unauthenticated
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "403":
          description: Forbidden
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.forbidden
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "404":
          description: Not found
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.not_found
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          description: Internal failure
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.internal_error
              retryable: false
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "503":
          description: Dependency unavailable
          headers:
            x-request-id:
              $ref: "#/components/headers/RequestId"
          x-kokoro-errors:
            - code: billing.dependency_unavailable
              retryable: true
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
    AdmissionCreateRequest:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      required:
        - run_id
        - request_ref
        - call_id
        - attempt_id
        - attempt_ordinal
        - feature_key
        - billing_subject
        - planned_binding_ref
        - planned_binding_digest
        - usage_profile_version
        - usage_profile_digest
        - execution_bound_ref
        - execution_bound_digest
      properties:
        run_id:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        request_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        call_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        attempt_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        attempt_ordinal:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PositiveDecimal"
        feature_key:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        billing_subject:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: false
          required:
            - kind
            - ref
          properties:
            kind:
              type: string
              enum:
                - user
                - project
                - organization
                - service
            ref:
              type: string
              minLength: 1
              maxLength: 255
        planned_binding_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        planned_binding_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
        usage_profile_version:
          type: string
          const: 2.0.0
        usage_profile_digest:
          type: string
          const: 552f0d22251837aaf4d83766c7bd91311984f707f9a42950ed53ac7127bb5504
        execution_bound_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        execution_bound_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
    Admission:
      type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      if:
        required:
          - dispatch_status
        properties:
          dispatch_status:
            const: started
      then:
        required:
          - authorization_status
        properties:
          authorization_status:
            const: authorized
      required:
        - admission_id
        - producer
        - run_id
        - request_ref
        - call_id
        - attempt_id
        - attempt_ordinal
        - feature_key
        - authorization_status
        - dispatch_status
        - evidence_status
        - charge_status
        - authorized_micros
        - snapshot_id
        - snapshot_digest
        - rate_revision_id
        - policy_revision_id
        - normalization_version
        - normalization_digest
        - rounding_version
        - currency_code
        - valid_until
        - planned_binding_ref
        - planned_binding_digest
        - usage_profile_version
        - usage_profile_digest
        - execution_bound_ref
        - execution_bound_digest
        - hold_id
        - created_at
        - updated_at
      properties:
        admission_id:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
        producer:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        run_id:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        request_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        call_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        attempt_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        attempt_ordinal:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/PositiveDecimal"
        feature_key:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 128
        authorization_status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - authorized
            - denied
            - expired
            - unknown
        dispatch_status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - awaiting
            - not_dispatched
            - started
            - unknown
        evidence_status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - awaiting
            - sealed_known
            - sealed_unknown
            - invalid
        charge_status:
          type: string
          enum:
            - pending_evidence
            - pending_review
            - partially_captured
            - captured
            - released
            - unknown
            - rejected
        authorized_micros:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/NonNegativeCreditMicros"
        snapshot_id:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
        snapshot_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
        rate_revision_id:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
        policy_revision_id:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Uuid"
        normalization_version:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 32
        normalization_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
        rounding_version:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 32
        currency_code:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/CurrencyCode"
        valid_until:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/UtcInstant"
        planned_binding_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        planned_binding_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
        usage_profile_version:
          type: string
          const: 2.0.0
        usage_profile_digest:
          type: string
          const: 552f0d22251837aaf4d83766c7bd91311984f707f9a42950ed53ac7127bb5504
        execution_bound_ref:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        execution_bound_digest:
          type: string
          pattern: ^[0-9a-f]{64}$
        hold_id:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: uuid
        created_at:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/UtcInstant"
        updated_at:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/UtcInstant"
